notes.title: The Roast – HotFix 0.3.4.3 is Live! 🎉
notes.notes: [p]Hello Coffee Lovers! ☕[/p][p]We’ve just pushed a new hotfix that tackles some critical bugs and smooths out the early-game flow.[/p][p][b]Updates & Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Seamless Tutorial Transition[/b] – Tutorial now flows directly into Day 1 with progress carried over.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Daily Report Fix[/b] – Fixed issue where report sometimes didn’t appear.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Customer Queueing Fix[/b] – Customers no longer get stuck at the back of the line.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Filter Coffee Machine[/b] – Fixed disappearing filters and inability to add new ones after loading.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Save System Cleanup[/b] – Saves only created once a day is completed, keeping the list tidy. ✅[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for the quick feedback — keep it coming! 🧡[/p]

notes.title: The Roast – HotFix 0.3.4.1
notes.notes: [p]Hello Coffee Lovers! ☕[/p][p]We’ve just pushed a small hotfix to smooth out some issues from version 0.3.4:[/p][list][*][p]Tray info no longer lingers in the panel after throwing it away.[/p][/*][*][p]Cup temperature now properly shows [b]Cold[/b] when it should.[/p][/*][*][p]Customers will now move to the correct counter if their package is placed there.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare bug where two customers could get stuck at the same counter, freezing the game.[/p][/*][*][p]You can no longer place more than one receipt on a tray or paper bag — a warning will pop up instead.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for the quick feedback — keep it coming![/p]

notes.title: ☕The Roast – Demo Update 0.3.4
notes.notes: [p]Hello Coffee Lovers![/p][p]Update 0.3.4 is here! This update introduces multilingual support, a new crowd system, bug fixes, and improvements to make your café even more lively.[/p][h3][b]Main Updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]New Languages Added[/b] – German, French, Italian, Spanish (Castilian), Spanish (Latin America), Portuguese (Brazil), Chinese (Simplified), Russian.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Crowd System[/b] – NPC crowds have been added. People now randomly walk around the environment.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where paper bags held by take-away customers remained in hand after loading a save (only for new saves).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug causing shelf packages to lose their holder references after loading, preventing new item placement.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where customers could disappear in certain situations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where skipping tutorial steps and delivering coffee early caused the tutorial to break.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where rapidly clicking a package while the customer was receiving it could allow taking it back.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where taking receipts out of trays or paper bags caused receipt data to be lost, allowing delivery without receipts.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where adding an undefined cup into a paper bag caused the cup to vanish and become unretrievable.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some incorrect warnings shown during order delivery.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a critical bug where delivering a [b]double espresso[/b] sometimes prevented XP gain and caused the XP popup to instantly disappear.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the [b]carafe[/b] kept heating even when empty.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added a [b]UI sensitivity setting[/b] (in addition to mouse sensitivity) for computer and terminals.[/p][/*][*][p]Receipts can no longer be thrown away.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated [b]Paper Bag panel[/b], also added to the carrying panel. Tray now also has a panel.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an additional [b]evening ambient sound[/b].[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: ☕ The Roast – Demo Update 0.3.3
notes.notes: [p]Hello Coffee Lovers![/p][p]0.3.3 is here! This update brings exciting new features, important bug fixes, and improvements to make managing your coffee shop even more enjoyable.[/p][p][b]Main Updates[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Tip System[/b] – Customers now leave tips based on the order amount and how well it was prepared. Serve with care for extra rewards![/p][/*][*][p][b]Dirty & Trash Cups[/b] – Dine-in cups can now be left dirty or completely unusable. Reusing dirty cups may upset customers or reduce your XP.[/p][/*][*][p][b]XP Feedback on Delivery[/b] – See exactly how much XP you earn and why after delivering orders.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Order Tracking Panel[/b] – All incoming orders are now listed in a dedicated panel for easier tracking.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Milk Carton & Supply Tracking[/b] – Added a panel to show remaining milk in cartons and new entries for carafe, milk & coffee packs, portafilters, coffee jars, and water jugs.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Floating Income/Expense Notifications[/b] – Sales, tips, and purchases now appear as satisfying floating text.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Italian Language Support[/b] added. 🇮🇹[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where products remained unused if customers were seated at the end of the day.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed rare bug where warning icons stayed above customers after a dog chase.[/p][/*][*][p]Lids now correctly return to their holder when placing a cup with a lid.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed potential causes of order panel freezes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed errors for large cups and double espressos despite correct preparation.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Enjoy the update, and as always, thanks for playing and sharing your feedback. It helps us make the game better every day![/p]

notes.title: ☕ The Roast – Demo Update 0.3.2
notes.notes: [p]Hello coffee lovers![/p][p][/p][p]Update 0.3.2 is here, and it’s packed with a brand-new language option, important bug fixes, and a small but handy improvement to make your café run smoother.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Main Update[/b][/p][list][*][p]Turkish language support is now available! 🇹🇷[/p][p](Change it from the Settings menu)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed order panel freeze at closing time.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed storage cup boxes keeping old references.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed box placement requiring looking at the floor first.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed empty cups showing old liquid amounts.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed portafilter coffee value not updating.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed customer pathfinding issues when closing the store.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed day cycle starting the next day instantly.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]You can now return unused cups to the cup dispenser.[/p][/*][/list][p]☕ Fresh coffee, fewer bugs — that’s how we like it. Thanks for playing and keep sending us your feedback! ❤️[/p]
